UnitStatement: DEC-021 (A7) coverage: the rendered-report seam routes through the Tauri renderer command only, with no fallback renderer in browser preview.
The rendered-report adapter composes the renderer input from session envelopes with explicit TBD markers.
The rendered-report panel refuses save and print while export is blocked.
The renderedReport test mocks @tauri-apps/api/core invoke to assert routing without a real Tauri runtime.
reportRenderService reports an explicit desktop-only route 'unavailable_browser_preview' in browser preview without invoking the backend.
In browser preview the render-service diagnostic contains REPORT-RENDERER-DESKTOP-ONLY.
In the Tauri runtime renderCalculationReport invokes the 'render_calculation_report' command and resolves route 'tauri_renderer'.
buildRenderableReportInput maps session envelopes into the renderer input with explicit TBD markers.
The renderable report_id is derived from the run id as 'report:run:<run_id>'.
When no saved project exists the model_input_summary persistence_ref.ref_id is 'TBD'.
The renderable report unit_system_ref is 'unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display'.
The report unit_display_summary preserves entered units with storage_convention 'entered_units_preserved' and no report-time conversion (conversion_performed false).
The renderable report defines 8 template_slots and 8 rendered_sections.
Each result row maps to row_id 'row:<result_id>', a label from family, a case_ref, a quantity_display '<value> <unit>', and a source_ref.
When a project summary exists the persistence_ref.ref_id becomes 'local_sqlite:project:<id>'.
RenderedReportPanel requires a solved mechanics result before rendering; the render control is disabled and a precondition notice is shown.
An unblocked render shows the canonical hash and offers save/print actions; the saved file is named 'openpipestress-report-<hash12>.html'.
While export is blocked the panel surfaces 'EXPORT BLOCKED', lists blocking reasons (e.g. ProhibitedProfessionalClaim), and hides the save and print actions.
In browser preview the rendered-report panel surfaces the explicit REPORT-RENDERER-DESKTOP-ONLY diagnostic and does not invoke the backend.
ResultExportPanel builds a result-export packet only when both a mechanics result and an analysis run are present.
The result-export download is a local JSON file named 'openpipestress-preview-results-<token>.json'.
When no result is available the panel prompts to run a mechanics preview to assemble a schema-first local result envelope for review and regression use.
Result export is a local technical-preview JSON envelope; stress-neutral CSV/JSON preview is available after a mechanics run, while public transport and local FEA package formats remain TBD.
The result-export packet sorts result values by id (localeCompare) for deterministic ordering.

The export_format_status baseline_format is schema_first_json_result_envelope with stress_neutral_csv_json_preview available; public transport protocol, local FEA package format, and external adapter formats are TBD.
The result envelope id is 'result-envelope:<run_id>'.
The solver_version names 'OpenPipeStress product_physics technical preview' version 0.1.0 with build ref local_fixture_preview.
Reproducibility records a model_hash with algorithm/canonicalization/value all TBD, run_hashes from run hashes, an audit_manifest_ref, and deterministic_ordering true.
The exported rule_pack_ref marks a user-supplied pack not loaded, with completeness_status missing_required_inputs and private_payload_redacted true.
Downstream use of the result envelope permits review, regression comparison, report consumption, headless automation, and governed downstream tooling.
quantityResult omits the metadata field when item metadata is absent and the family is neither force nor moment.
resultMetadata defaults component, coordinate_system, and basis to TBD, location to 'summary', and sign_convention to a preview-not-expanded note when not provided.
resultExportDiagnostic maps severity 'error' to 'blocking' and otherwise preserves the source severity.

diagnosticClass classifies a diagnostic by code substring: RULE -> RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, PROVENANCE -> PROVENANCE_WARNING, UNIT -> UNIT_WARNING, blocking/error -> EXPORT_BLOCKING, else ASSUMPTION_WARNING.
resultFamily classifies a result by kind or id substring into displacement, reaction, force, moment, stress, or ratio (default ratio).
resultDimension maps family to dimension: displacement->length, reaction/force->force, moment->moment, stress->stress, ratio->dimensionless, rotation kind->angle, else TBD.
boundarySummary asserts 'human review required; no compliance, certification, sealing, authentication, or approval claim' only when human_review_required and no professional-claim flags are set.
jsonDataHref encodes a payload as a data:application/json URI for local download.
The Results panel offers result page sizes of 50, 100, and 200, defaulting to 50.
Result families are displacement, reaction, force, moment, stress, ratio, and other.
ResultsPanel filters, paginates, and groups mechanics result rows and builds a result interpretation for the selected row.
Result rows are grouped by family into tables showing ID, Entity, Location, and Value columns.
When no rows match the filter the panel shows 'No computed preview result rows match this filter.'
When no result is present the panel prompts to run the bounded preview mechanics path to populate result summaries.
ResultDetail prompts to select a computed result row to inspect recovery context and review boundary when none is selected.
An endpoint-pair table is shown for results that have a paired end-i/end-j endpoint, listing Location, Result, and Value.
The Mechanics Gap Ledger surfaces capability, status, and review note for each preview mechanics gap.
paginateResults clamps the page index into range and computes 1-based start, end, page index, and page count.
filterResults matches a lowercased query across id, kind, entity_ref, unit, value, basis ref, metadata fields, and source_result_refs.
resultFamilyKey classifies a result into displacement, reaction, force, moment, stress, ratio, or 'other' by kind/id substring.
buildResultInterpretation returns null when the selected result id is not found in the result rows.
Result interpretation links diagnostics whose affected_refs include the result id or its entity_ref.
Result interpretation counts result-value hashes from the analysis run's matching result_ref hash_refs.
Envelope hash availability is true when an analysis-run hash has payload_scope 'result_envelope'.
Interpretation defaults coordinate_system to 'result_envelope', location to 'summary', and sign_convention to 'not specified in result metadata' when absent.
Result interpretation professional_boundary is 'human review required; review-only interpretation; no compliance or professional approval claim'.
buildDiagnosticInterpretation links results and knowledge to a diagnostic by affected_refs and returns null when the diagnostic is not found.
Diagnostic interpretation professional_boundary is 'review-only diagnostic explanation; no compliance or professional approval claim'.
resolveEntitySelection resolves an entity ref to a node, pipe, support, component, or load case by matching model collections.
resolveDiagnosticEntitySelection resolves a diagnostic's affected_refs to a model entity directly or via the referenced result's entity_ref.
mechanicsGaps enumerates preview mechanics capability gaps with id, capability, status, and review_note.
Endpoint-j local force/moment recovery is implemented: end-i and end-j local force/moment preview results are emitted and paired; arbitrary station sweeps remain deferred.
Endpoint stress component recovery is implemented: end-i and end-j open-mechanics stress component preview results are emitted and paired when stress recovery succeeds.

Intermediate station recovery emits fixed station-grid force, moment, shear-force, and stress rows from interpolated endpoint resultants; arbitrary sweeps, exact internal diagrams, and shear-stress recovery remain deferred.
Pressure-to-frame load conversion applies closed-end pressure thrust for straight preview pipes to frame resultants; broader pressure behavior remains deferred.

Thermal behavior implements uniform axial temperature-change loads for straight preview pipes with explicit material expansion input; temperature-dependent properties and thermal combinations remain deferred.
Support stiffness completeness is deferred: linear support restraints are preview inputs, and richer or nonlinear stiffness requires explicit data.
Load combinations are implemented for explicit mechanics-basis user combinations from matching scalar load-case rows; code/rule combinations remain deferred or private.
Protected rule/code checks require private inputs: private criteria, allowables, SIF/flexibility tables, and code checks are not bundled publicly.
endpointPairFor pairs end-i/end-j results only for force, moment, or stress families matching entity_ref, component, coordinate system, and basis, requiring at least two values.
resultInterpretation resultFamily defaults to 'TBD' when no family substring matches (contrast with ResultsPanel default 'ratio'/'other').
A StableIdMapEntry carries stable_id, canonical_family, export_status (emitted|approximated|metadata_only|omitted), gltf_ref, and review_note.
A CoordinateUnitWitness records source and target refs, source/target quantities, conversion_performed false, and an axis_transform mapping preview Z-up to glTF Y-up.
The review-geometry export downloads a glTF JSON file named 'openpipestress-preview-review-geometry-<token>.gltf.json'.
Review geometry is visual context only; it is not solver geometry, target compatibility evidence, or professional validation.
The review-geometry packet document_kind is openpipestress.technical_preview.review_geometry_export with review_geometry_status visual_review_geometry_only.
The review-geometry profile targets glTF 2.0 JSON (target_artifact glTF_2_0_json_preview, extension .gltf.json) while the GLB binary writer status is TBD.
Review-geometry source coordinates treat the source vertical axis as +Z and target glTF right-handed +Y-up meters, with transform_policy preview_z_up_to_gltf_y_up_rotation_x_minus_90.
Review-geometry primitive topology: pipe_segments as LINES, nodes as POINTS, supports and components as approximated POINTS markers.

The review-geometry unit_system_disclosure references unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display, performs no unit conversion, applies the Z-up to Y-up axis transform, and preserves source model units as meter quantities.
Review-geometry coverage emits pipe_segments and nodes, approximates supports and components, and omits materials, load_cases, and combinations.
Review-geometry TBD families include bends as curved surfaces, equipment interfaces, annotations, and load-case visual overlays.
The review-geometry package includes glTF-json, id_map, loss_report, and coordinate_unit_witnesses members, each with hash_status TBD in browser preview.
buildGltfPositionGroups builds LINES centerline groups for pipe segments and POINTS marker groups for nodes, supports, and components, dropping empty groups.
buildCoordinateUnitWitnesses emits per-axis witnesses mapping source x/y/z to glTF x/z/y with y negated, preserving units while transforming axes.
buildGltfAsset packs all positions into a Float32 buffer with per-group bufferViews (target 34962) and VEC3 float accessors carrying min/max bounds.
The glTF buffer is embedded as a data:application/octet-stream;base64 URI in the JSON download.
stableIdEntries builds the sidecar ID map: project metadata_only, materials/load_cases/combinations omitted, nodes/pipe_segments emitted, supports/components approximated point markers.
reviewGeometryLossReport enumerates approximation/omission losses for centerline-only segments, point-marker supports/components, omitted loads/combinations, and TBD GLB/viewer behavior.
reviewGeometryDiagnostics emits REVIEW-GEOMETRY-UNITS-METERED (info) when length unit is meters or REVIEW-GEOMETRY-UNITS-TBD (blocking) otherwise, plus a REVIEW-GEOMETRY-VISUAL-ONLY warning.
gltfPosition transforms a source position (x,y,z) to glTF (x, z, -y).
round normalizes numeric coordinates to 6 decimal places.
professionalBoundary asserts human_review_required true and all solver-geometry-equivalence, target-compatibility, compliance, certification, sealing, approval, and authentication claims false.
A rule-check WarningClass is one of RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING, PROVENANCE_WARNING, ASSUMPTION_WARNING, or IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING.

A CompletenessFinding carries finding_id, warning_class, severity, affected/source refs, message, remediation, and flags for private data, protected content, mechanics-solve blocking, and rule-check blocking.
The rule-check completeness export downloads a local JSON file named 'openpipestress-preview-rule-completeness-<token>.json'.

Completeness findings explain missing user/private rule-check data; mechanics preview output remains review-only and is not a compliance, approval, certification, sealing, or professional acceptance result.
The rule completeness review document_kind is openpipestress.technical_preview.rule_completeness_review with export_scope local_browser_download_preview.

The completeness summary reports finding_count, rule_check_blocked, blocking/warning counts, mechanics_results_reviewable, and false flags for silent defaults, bundled code values, and compliance claims.
buildFindings raises a RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING finding when rule_check status includes incomplete, missing, or not_performed.
The required-rule-inputs-missing finding states user-supplied rule-pack inputs are absent and the public preview does not bundle code defaults.
A PROVENANCE_WARNING is raised for components whose provenance indicates no flexibility factor / stress-intensification data, requiring user-supplied or privately imported correction data.
A RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING finding flags that load cases/combinations are mechanics-basis preview inputs, not code-specific rule combinations, requiring private owner/code criteria.
A PROVENANCE_WARNING flags material and pipe-section values as invented public fixture values, not verified project or catalog data.
An ASSUMPTION_WARNING is raised when professional acceptance is not_provided, requiring a human authority to record acceptance outside the software.
ruleBoundary summarizes 'private rule data absent; silent defaults used=false; bundled code values=false; no compliance claim'.
Phase C4 GUI slice (TP-C4-CHECKGUI-001): jsdom has no Tauri runtime, so browser-preview tests pin the honest desktop-only seam while the desktop-render test opts into the backend path.
The unit catalog stub is unit-system:dec-018-si-dual-display with si_canonical calculation basis and entered_units_preserved storage, containing pascal, kilopascal, megapascal, and ratio entries.
The unit catalog boundary asserts no protected content, no private project data, no professional approval, and no code-compliance claim.
RuleCheckRunPanel surfaces project scope and a no-solve reason ('create or open a local project first'; 'No solved mechanics result') honestly.
RuleCheckRunPanel disables Run until a rule pack is loaded.
Loading the bundled demo pack derives binding controls: solver-result inputs become result-row selects and user value/slot inputs become entry fields.
In desktop mode the panel loads the DEC-018 unit catalog via get_unit_catalog and offers runtime value units (e.g. MPa) as a SELECT.
An invalid pasted rule pack reports RULE-CHECK-PACK-JSON-INVALID and keeps Run disabled.
A private_library_value input surfaces a private library reference (material:lib:steel, slot allow:Sh) that is never embedded in the rule pack.
An authored solver_result_ref is surfaced as canonical, supersedes the run-panel selector, and previews a resolving result row at run time.
A missing authored solver_result_ref is reported as result_missing (RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE) without inventing a fallback binding.
In browser preview running rule checks reports the desktop-only seam RULE-CHECK-BACKEND-DESKTOP-ONLY and shows no run result.
A desktop rule-check run renders per-check outcomes and the aggregate, surfacing computed value, the acceptability relation (TP-C4-ACCEPTREL-001), and the not-a-professional-claim boundary.
When a solver_result_ref is authored in the pack, caller-supplied solver bindings are omitted from the run_rule_checks invocation.
Phase C4 app-held envelope wiring (TP-C4-APPAGG-001): the panel lifts the worst-of rule-check aggregate to the app via onAggregateChange.
On a desktop run the panel lifts the worst-of aggregate (e.g. USER_RULE_FAILED) to onAggregateChange.
The lifted aggregate is cleared (null) when a new pack is loaded and on the desktop-only browser seam.

Phase C3 resolution-preview/browse picker (TP-C3-LIBREFPICKER-001): a Preview resolution action queries the local store (desktop-only) and reports whether a library reference resolves without mutating the pack.
A resolving library reference previews and browses local records/slots via list_local_libraries and open_local_library, marking referenced records/slots.
A library reference pointing nowhere reports library_missing and short-circuits before open_local_library.
The preview distinguishes record_missing from slot_missing against the stored library and notes it blocks at RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE.
In browser preview a library reference preview reports status unavailable with LIBRARY-IMPORT-BACKEND-DESKTOP-ONLY.
